maintainer_pilot.eligibility_rule: An MCP package maintainer explicitly invokes the existing strict umbrella check for a real PR changing at least one mcp/*/package.json; both built-ins still scan the complete set of changed files. No fixture/path exemptions. Select prospectively and record all eligible inputs; this historical grouping is an exploratory example.
maintainer_pilot.safe_scope: Only a non-required maintainer trial with protected masking, review and documentation of each finding and scan failure, opt-in strict execution on a nonempty real base/head diff, and a revert to the ordinary disabled/shadow configuration. Retain the security subcheck for decisions, since umbrella failures may be unrelated. Strict failure must be reported as such; no automatic exemptions or claim of clean security.
maintainer_pilot.eligibility_is_not_accuracy: In this operationally defined historical slice 8 passed and 1 flagged an official AWS test example. There are no actionable secret or dependency findings to establish precision. No unattended merge requirement or strict default supported. No current-SHA pilot was executed by this disposition exercise; the net-tested code identity does not replace current-SHA real-PR evidence.

hosted_archive.lookup: All GitHub repository Actions artifact pages, de-duplicated by ID, matched by workflow_run.head_sha to final PR head or actual merge SHA. ZIP members inspected for literal mapped state and event keys, without execution.

limits: Only specified committed final-head regular text file formats, literal model field keys and consecutive raw records, JSON arrays or line records. Alternate serialization, past pushes and unarchived records are unknown.
Actions inspections use currently listed artifacts whose recorded SHA matches the final head/merge. Deleted artifacts, runs keyed to other synthetic SHAs, and raw Actions logs are outside the check.

future_collection.capture: On a normal mapped PR, record Init and each observed transition in one real task/lock session as consecutive NDJSON. Store event step/action, required actor and the full state fields declared in mapping.json. Read actual state at each step; preserve missing data as unevaluable.
future_collection.bind: Bind PR base/head, workflow ID and attempt, model and mapping digests, source digests, trace digest and capture provenance. Preserve raw trace plus results and three TLC termination outcomes before retention expires.
future_collection.count: Group repeated samples and replays by source PR/session/finding; manually adjudicate actual findings before computing a rate. Keep synthetic exercises and expected mutation counterexamples separate.

lint_performance.protocol: Collect tracked .js/.mjs/.cjs/.ts/.tsx/.jsx paths under plugins/ and mcp/ at the candidate. Sort by SHA-256(path UTF-8) for hash order, or by descending bytes then path for largest. Exclude dist/ only from the two authored selections. Build a private comparison tree by removing the selected 100 paths from the candidate tree. Run the public run-agent-lint.mjs --root <candidate clone> --diff-only --base-ref <comparison commit> --mode strict in a fresh Node process each time. Measure monotonic wall time including startup. OS caches uncontrolled. These modeled all-added diffs and their diagnostics do not enter field accuracy.
lint_performance.target_checkout_install: Three sets measured without target MCP dependencies. Repeat the same largest set including bundles after npm ci --offline --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --prefix mcp/sdd-forge-mcp. Tools use the candidate checkout. The transitive inspector package emitted an engine-range warning during install.
